recommendations.name: Risk-based triage with volume throttling
recommendations.description: Sort PRs by size and sensitivity so small low-risk changes get a quick peer check while auth, payments and infrastructure changes get senior or pair review, and throttle agent output when pending reviews pass about five per reviewer; the evidence is small and observational, and it was dropped on a three-person team.

recommendations.name: AI-assisted first-pass review that surfaces high-risk areas
recommendations.description: Run automated analysis when each PR opens that groups related changes, flags security and architecture issues with severity and reasoning, and puts a summary in the PR so humans review intent and the riskiest parts first; Salesforce keeps humans in the loop rather than merging unreviewed.

recommendations.name: Automated quality, security and policy gates before human review
recommendations.description: Require checks to pass before a human looks, treat AI output as untrusted input, and keep PRs small, so reviewers spend their time on architecture and correctness (this one is a vendor blog, which I only read as a search summary and did not fetch).
